svg.title: SFU server discovery
svg.desc: The SFU instance manager monitors SFU servers in every region and keeps their connection counts in DynamoDB: instance A has N connections, instance B N-1, instance Z N+1. The Switch 2 asks the group server which instance to use (1); the group server reads DynamoDB and returns instance B, the least loaded (2); the Switch 2 then opens a WebRTC connection to instance B in Region 2 (3).
